bioconda.name: deeprok
bioconda.summary: Neural prokaryotic gene finder (CNN+BiLSTM + segmental ORF HMM)
bioconda.description:
Predicts protein-coding genes in bacterial and archaeal genomes. A CNN+BiLSTM
trained on 666 GTDB family representatives scores every base; a segmental ORF
HMM decodes complete genes; a start-site ranker self-trained on the input genome
refines translation starts. Writes GFF3, protein and CDS FASTA.
